test_case_name: Open search field and perform a search (desktop)

intents.intent: Click the 'Search' button to open the search field (desktop)
Type $name into the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field
Click the 'Cerca (desktop)' button to submit the search
And then check that the search results are displayed for $name

test_case_name: Reset search field (desktop)

intents.intent: Click the 'Search' button to open the search field (desktop)
Click the 'Reset ricerca (desktop)' button to clear the search input
And then check that the search input field is cleared

test_case_name: Perform a search using the mobile search field

intents.intent: Type $name into the 'Cerca' input field (mobile)
Click the 'Cerca (mobile)' button to submit the search
And then check that the search results are displayed for $name on mobile

test_case_name: Login as guest user on desktop

intents.intent: Type $email into the 'E-mail' input field
Type $password into the 'Password' input field
Click the 'ENTRA' button to log in as a guest user (desktop)
And then check that the user is logged in as a guest on desktop

test_case_name: Enable 'Mantieni L'accesso' option during guest login (desktop)

intents.intent: Type $email into the 'E-mail' input field
Type $password into the 'Password' input field
Click the 'Mantieni L'accesso' checkbox to enable keep me logged in
Click the 'ENTRA' button to log in as a guest user (desktop)
And then check that the user is logged in and the session is persistent

test_case_name: Recover password from guest login (desktop)

intents.intent: Click the 'Recupera Password' link to initiate password recovery (desktop)
And then check that the password recovery process is started

test_case_name: Register as a new guest user (desktop)

intents.intent: Click the 'Registrati' link to start the registration process (desktop)
And then check that the registration page is displayed

test_case_name: Login as guest user on mobile

intents.intent: Type $email into the 'E-mail' input field (mobile)
Type $password into the 'Password' input field (mobile)
Click the 'ENTRA' button to log in as a guest user (mobile)
And then check that the user is logged in as a guest on mobile

test_case_name: Register as a new guest user (mobile)

intents.intent: Click the 'REGISTRATI' button to start the registration process (mobile)
And then check that the registration page is displayed on mobile

test_case_name: Recover password from guest login (mobile)

intents.intent: Click the 'Recupera password' link to initiate password recovery (mobile)
And then check that the password recovery process is started on mobile
